verses.text: Come near, O nations, to hear; and pay attention O peoples! Let the earth hear, and its fullness, the world, and all its offspring.

verses.text: For wrath [is] unto YHWH against all the nations, and rage against all their hosts; He has devoted them to destruction, He has given them over to the slaughter!

segments.text: For wrath [is] unto YHWH against all the nations, and rage against all their hosts; He has devoted them to destruction, He has given them over to the slaughter!

verses.text: And their slain will be thrown out, and [from] their corpses their stench will rise, and the mountains will flow with their blood.

segments.text: And their slain will be thrown out, and [from] their corpses their stench will rise, and the mountains will flow with their blood.

verses.text: And all the host of heavens will be made to rot, and the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll; and all their host will fade away, like the fading of a leaf from the vine and like a falling from a fig tree.

segments.text: And all the host of heavens will be made to rot, and the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll; and all their host will fade away, like the fading of a leaf from the vine and like a falling from a fig tree.

verses.text: For in the heavens My sword has drunk its fill; behold, upon Edom it will come down, and upon the people I have devoted to judgment.

segments.text: For in the heavens My sword has drunk its fill; behold, upon Edom it will come down, and upon the people I have devoted to judgment.

verses.text: The sword of YHWH has been full of blood, dripping with fat [and] with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for a sacrifice [is] unto YHWH in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

verses.text: And the wild oxen will go down with them and the young bulls with the mighty ones; and their land will be watered with blood, and their dust will be soaked with fat.

verses.text: For a day of vengeance [is] unto YHWH, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

segments.text: For a day of vengeance [is] unto YHWH, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

verses.text: And her streams will be turned to pitch, and her dust to brimstone, and her land will become a burning pitch.

verses.text: Night and day it will not be quenched; her smoke will ascend forever; she will be desolate from generation to generation; no one will pass through her forever and ever;

verses.text: and the hawk and the hedgehog will dispossess her, and the owl and the raven will dwell in her; and He will stretch out over her a measuring line of confusion, and a plumb line of emptiness.

verses.text: And nothing [is] there for her nobles to call a kingdom, and all her princes will be nothing.

verses.text: And thorns will come up in her palaces, thistles and briers in her fortresses; and she will be a habitation of jackals, a courtyard for daughters of the ostrich.

verses.text: And the desert creatures will meet with the jackals, and the wild goat will bleat alongside his companion; indeed, Lilith will rest there and find for herself a place of rest,

verses.text: Search from the book of YHWH and recite: Not one of these will go missing, a female will not lack her mate. For His mouth has commanded it, and by His Spirit He has gathered them.
